onbVerdictsBody.message: The model ($1, ICLR 2026) rates how far a paragraph sits between untouched human writing (.00) and fully AI-generated text (1.0). The number is $2 written by AI — it is the model's estimate of how much AI editing changed the text as a whole. Hover (or tap) a chip for the full readout: the four-way probability split behind the verdict and the word count. EditLens reads English only: other languages get a gray chip with the detected language code instead of a number. Every number is an $3. Snippets under ~50 words are only scored when grouped with neighbors, and a short post is scored as a whole — a $4 on a chip means it covers that many paragraphs.
onbVerdictsBody.description: First-run card body. $1-$4 are emphasised runs from the page (the model name, onbNotShare, onbEstimate, and the ×2 example).

onbBallBody.message: Lives bottom-right on every page Anagram runs on. $1 it to show or hide all marks instantly. $2 it anywhere — it snaps to the nearest edge and tucks itself half-away when idle; hover brings it back. Its red $3 opens the triage panel: filter by verdict, jump to each flagged paragraph, $4, or turn Anagram off for this site — all inside the panel.

onbDocsBody.message: Docs is an editor, not a page — so Anagram brings its own reading surface. Click $1 on the floating ball and a $2 opens right in the tab, with every paragraph of the document analyzed. No navigation, and your file is never touched. Press $3 or $4 to return instantly — or use $5 if you prefer a separate tab.

onbPdfBody.message: A PDF keeps its own pages: Anagram draws them exactly as they are — figures, formulas, columns — and lays the chips and marks over them. Click $1 on the floating ball, $2 in the popup, or right-click a link to one and choose $3. Short paragraphs are read together as on any page, a password-protected file asks for its password, and the file stays on your computer. For a PDF that is already on your computer, open the reading mode from the options page and drop the file in.

componentConnectionNote.message: The browser starts the installed component automatically. If this is your first setup, install it once below.

componentInstallIntro.message: Install the local component once for this browser. Both the browser-store version and the ZIP contain only the extension.

componentInitialDownload.message: First setup downloads about 4.07 GB of model files, plus the local runtime. Allow extra disk space during installation. Model downloads and the first benchmark start automatically after connection.

componentTerminal.message: Open Terminal, paste this command, and press Return:

componentPowerShell.message: Open PowerShell, paste this command, and press Enter:

componentUnreleased.message: Development build: this version’s installer has not been published. The version-pinned command is shown for review; wait for the matching release before running it.

componentAfterInstall.message: Keep this page open. Once it connects, you can close the terminal; manage downloads, devices, updates, and removal here from then on.

componentCopyFailed.message: Copying failed. Select the command and copy it manually.

componentUnsupportedPlatform.message: An installation command is available for macOS, Linux, and Windows with a supported extension ID. Open this page in your installed extension.

componentConnectedNote.message: You can close the terminal. The browser manages the local component; progress continues while this page is closed.

componentReconnectNote.message: The browser will retry the connection. If it keeps failing, reopen this page after checking the installation.

componentIncompatible.message: The local component needs an update

componentPausing.message: Pausing after the current download operation…

componentDownloadFailed.message: The download did not finish. Resume or retry when your connection and disk space are ready.

componentOperationFailed.message: The local operation failed. Review the details and retry the appropriate action.

componentActionRejected.message: The component could not start this action. Wait for the current operation or review the details, then retry.

componentActionUnconfirmed.message: The connection ended before this action was confirmed. Check the status before trying again.

componentDeleteConfirm.message: Stop the engine and delete $1 of model files from $2? The local component and extension stay installed. You can download the models again later.

componentUninstallTitle.message: Remove Anagram and its local files?

componentUninstallConfirm.message: Stop the engine, remove the local component and browser registration at $2, including $1 of model files, then remove this extension? Other browser profiles using this component will also lose access to it.

componentCleanupUnconfirmed.message: The connection closing does not confirm removal. Keep the extension installed until cleanup succeeds.

componentCleanupScheduled.message: Cleanup is running in a system window

componentSystemCleanupNote.message: Follow the result in the system window. After it confirms successful cleanup, remove this extension from your browser’s extension manager. A closed connection alone does not confirm success.

componentRemovingExtension.message: Local cleanup is confirmed. Removing the browser extension…

componentExtensionRemovalFailed.message: Local cleanup succeeded, but extension removal was not confirmed. Use the button to retry, or remove Anagram in your browser’s extension manager.

componentUpgradeNote.message: Browser-store extensions update through the browser. For a ZIP installation, replace the unpacked extension with the new ZIP’s contents and reload it. Update the local component with the button above.

componentReadyManual.message: Ready. Use the toolbar’s Analyze this page for one-time access, or optionally allow sites above.

componentInstallWaiting.message: Install and connect the local component to finish setup.

componentOpenSettingsHint.message: Open Settings for setup progress, model downloads, and local engine controls.

componentUpdateScheduled.message: Update is running in a system window
componentUpdateScheduled.description: Native component or browser extension update UI: componentUpdateScheduled.

componentSystemUpdateNote.message: Keep the system progress window open until it reports the result. The browser will reconnect to the updated component after it finishes.
componentSystemUpdateNote.description: Native component or browser extension update UI: componentSystemUpdateNote.

componentReloadExtension.description: Native component or browser extension update UI: componentReloadExtension.

componentExtensionUpdate.message: Extension version $1 is ready. Reload to install it; this restarts the extension and temporarily disconnects the local engine.
componentExtensionUpdate.description: Native component or browser extension update UI: componentExtensionUpdate.

componentInUse.description: Native host lock conflict, distinct from a missing installation.
